body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> BlackBerry showcased its thin and light full-qwerty smartphone 'BlackBerry Curve 8900' at 2009 CES, which is expected to be available via T-Mobile in U.S market in February.

The elegant and sophisticated BlackBerry Curve 8900 includes popular features like built-in GPS and location-based services like real-time, turn-by-turn directions, Wi-Fi connectivity for voice and data and full e-mail and messaging options in order to stay connected to your personal and professional life.

Adopting a large, vivid screen as well as a 512 MHz next generation processor for fast and responsive performance, it features a hot-swappable microSD card slot with a 256MB memory card inserted, music/video playback and a3.2-megapixel camera with image stabilization, digital zoom, flash and the ability to record.
